chunks: And from him (Al-Hassan ibn Muhammad al-Umari) from Al-Barqi from Dharih al-Muharibi who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who forgot to say Takbir (Allahu Akbar) until he had already recited (the Quran), and he said, 'He should say Takbir.'
ai.seo_question: What should a person do if they forget to say Takbir before reciting Quran in prayer?
ai.summary: In this concise ruling from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, the missed initial Takbir is treated as a minor omission that does not invalidate the prayer, reflecting the Shia principle of ease (*taysir*) in ritual acts. Unlike major errors requiring *sajdah al-tilawah* or *sajdah al-sahw*, this simple verbal acknowledgment preserves the continuity of the worshipper’s connection with God, emphasizing the spiritual intent over rigid mechanical perfection.
